agyos_skill.intent: Programmatic mathematical animation and technical explainer engine using 3Blue1Brown's Manim (manimlib/manimgl) for 2D/3D geometry, calculus, linear algebra, coordinate transformations, and headless video rendering.
agyos_skill.instructions: This skill guides the construction and rendering of programmatic mathematical animations and technical explainer videos using 3Blue1Brown's original animation engine ([3b1b/manim](https://github.com/3b1b/manim)). Understanding the distinction between the two primary Manim ecosystems prevents syntax and import failures: | Feature | 3Blue1Brown Manim (`3b1b/manim`) | Manim Community (`ManimCommunity/manim`) | |---|---|---| | **Python Import** | `from manimlib import *` | `from manim import *` | | **CLI Command** | `manimgl` | `manim` | | **Rendering Engine** | Modern OpenGL + ModernGL shaders | Cairo + FFmpeg / ModernGL | | **Interactivity** | Native interactive inspection window | Experimental via `--write_to_movie` / `-p` | | **Camera Control** | `self.frame` (Euler angles, focal distance) | `self.camera` (CameraFrame) | | **Creation Animation** | `ShowCreation(mobject)` | `Create(mobject)` | To render animations without opening a GUI window, pass the `-w` (write) flag: ```bash manimgl path/to/scene.py SceneClassName -w -l manimgl path/to/scene.py SceneClassName -w --hd manimgl path/to/scene.py SceneClassName -w --uhd manimgl path/to/scene.py SceneClassName -s ``` Common flags: - `-w` / `--write_file`: Write the scene directly to a video file. - `-o` / `--open`: Write to file and open in default media player. - `-s` / `--save_last_frame`: Output a single PNG image of the final frame. - `-l` / `--low_quality`: 480p @ 30 fps (ideal for smoke tests). - `--hd`: 1080p @ 60 fps. - `-t` / `--transparent`: Render with alpha transparency channel.
